title: 12 Beach Gadgets You'll Actually Use This Summer
excerpt: From sand-free blankets to mini fans, these are the beach picks our team is loving in 2026.
content: Summer 2026 is here and the beach kit upgrades are real. We tested handheld misters, sand-free blankets, waterproof pouches and more. The list below is built around comfort, packability and price.

title: TikTok Made Me Buy It: 10 Viral Summer Picks
excerpt: The For You Page does not lie. These are the products worth the hype.
content: Some viral products fizzle in a week. Others, like the mini portable blender and oversized claw clips, keep showing up because they actually work. Here are ten viral favorites we keep going back to.

title: Aesthetic Room Refresh for Under $25
excerpt: Soft glow, cozy textures and tiny upgrades that make a big difference.
content: You don't need a full redesign to refresh a room. Sunset lamps, cloud lights and pastel hair claws on the dresser bring serious Pinterest energy without the price tag.
